kena_chapter1_verse5.title: Kena Chapter 1 Verse 5
kena_chapter1_verse5.introduction: This verse belongs to Kena, Chapter 1.
kena_chapter1_verse5.scripture_text: A representative contemplative passage from the Kena Upanishad, Chapter 1, Verse 5, reflecting the inquiry into Atman, Brahman, and liberation through self-knowledge.
kena_chapter1_verse5.philosophical_explanation: This verse extends the contemplative teaching tradition of the Upanishads toward self-knowledge and liberation.
